description: This file defines a React component named ChartsSection, along with auxiliary icon and chart-building components used to visualize coverage and freshness data as sparklines and icons in a dashboard UI.

methods.name: TrendUpIcon
methods.description: A functional React component rendering an SVG icon indicating upward trend.

methods.name: BarChartIcon
methods.description: A functional React component rendering a bar chart SVG icon.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to clamp a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: buildPolyline
methods.description: Builds a SVG polyline points string from an array of points.

methods.name: Sparkline
methods.description: React component rendering a small inline line chart (sparkline) based on input numeric values.

methods.name: ChartsSection
methods.description: Main React component aggregating coverage and freshness trends into a dashboard section with icons and sparklines.
